headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 29, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. hitting 3 home runs and driving in 5 runs. The Cincinnati Reds fell to the Pittsburgh Pirates 9-4, with Ryan O'Hearn leading the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes leading the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Jacob Wilson, a shortstop for the Athletics, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right thumb inflammation. Tyler Soderstrom, also of the Athletics, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left hip impingement. Other notable injuries include Anthony Banda's left lat strain with the Minnesota Twins, David Morgan's left knee inflammation with the San Diego Padres, and Richard Lovelady's left triceps strain with the Washington Nationals.

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. Other notable trades include the Chicago Cubs acquiring left-hander David Peterson from the New York Mets and the St. Louis Cardinals trading right-hander Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, with a strong performance from Luis García Jr. who hit 3 home runs and drove in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Ryan O'Hearn leading the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Julian Garcia pitched 1.1 scoreless innings for the Reds, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, securing a 3-2 win. Nathan Lukes led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Josh Hader earning the win. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Jacob Wilson on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics shortstop Jacob Wilson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right thumb inflammation, with the move retroactive to June 26, 2026. Wilson will miss at least the next 10 days.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash.
